evidence_excerpts: The analysis shows the traditional RIS weight underestimates the inverse PDF when some candidate PDFs are zero; MIS weights m(xz)=pz(xz)/sum_i pi(xz) restore an unbiased estimator.
text: A modified RIS weight using candidate-PDF multiple importance weights can remove bias introduced by mixing samples from different pixel distributions, though visibility-aware unbiased reuse costs extra rays.
